title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Microsoft now displays the full name of the Country/Region when creating a new environment
summary: The Business Central Admin Center now displays the full country/region name instead of abbreviations when creating new environments. This improvement simplifies environment setup by eliminating the need to reference external mapping tables to understand country codes.
key_points: Business Central Admin Center now shows full country/region names during environment creation instead of abbreviations
The country selection determines both the localization and Azure region for the environment
Administrators can create environments for any supported country/region in any available version
Manual input is supported for country selection

quotes.text: The specified country determines the localization for the environment and the Azure region in which the environment is created and stored
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the practical impact of country selection on environment configuration and infrastructure

quotes.text: Now it finally displays the full name instead of just showing the Environment country/region abbreviation
quotes.why_it_matters: Emphasizes the usability improvement made in the Admin Center interface
